# DeNoise

> DeNoise is an alert hub: it ingests alerts from Azure Monitor, MongoDB Atlas and generic webhooks, deduplicates them into episodes by fingerprint, assigns an owning team by routing policy, auto-resolves on versioned lifecycle policies with recorded evidence, verifies monitoring coverage with registered heartbeats and canaries, and delivers notifications through templated, HMAC-signed outbound webhooks and SMTP email. Single deployable modular application: three .NET 10 hosts (ingest, api, workers), a React 19 SPA, PostgreSQL 16 as the only infrastructure dependency (storage, job queue and transactional outbox). Pre-release; milestones 0-12 complete; no licence file yet.

Repository: https://github.com/gr4b4z/DeNoise
Site: https://gr4b4z.github.io/DeNoise/
OpenAPI 3.1 document (executable contract, drift-checked in CI): https://gr4b4z.github.io/DeNoise/openapi/v1.json

## Key facts

- Hosts: `ingest` (public: `/ingest/*`, `/hb/*`, `/healthz/*`), `api` (authenticated: `/api/v1/*`, `/auth/*`, SSE, `/healthz/*`), `workers` (roles `processing`, `scheduler`, `dispatcher`; `/healthz/*`), `migrator` (EF Core migrations; `seed-dev` command). All containers listen on :8080 as non-root. Docker Compose maps api :8080, ingest :8081, workers :8082, Mailpit :8025, PostgreSQL :5432; Vite dev server :5173.
- Ingestion: `POST /ingest/{integrationKeyId}` with `Authorization: Bearer <integration token>`; body <= 256 KiB, any content type, stored as-is; optional `X-DeNoise-Source-Time` (RFC 3339); Atlas integrations may carry `X-MMS-Signature` (HMAC sha1/sha256, base64/hex, required or verify-only). Responses: 202 `{eventId, receivedAt}` only after the raw event and a `normalise` job are committed; 401 invalid key/token; 413 too large; 429 per-integration limit (initial 600/min, `Retry-After`); 503 durable acceptance failed (retry). No other codes.
- Generic webhook canonical body (default `generic` mapping is identity): `{eventType: firing|resolved|update|cancelled, alertId, eventId, occurredAt, severity: critical|high|medium|low|informational, resource{id,name}, rule{id,name}, environment, service, summary, dimensions{}, url}`.
- Heartbeat ping (dead man's switch): `GET|POST /hb/{keyId}.{token}`, `POST .../start`, `POST .../fail`, `POST .../exit/{code}`; optional text body <= 16 KiB stored as run output tail; 200 `{ok:true}`, 404 unknown/rotated (constant-time), 429 per key (60/min). Ping URL is returned exactly once by `POST /api/v1/heartbeats` or `.../rotate-token`.
- Outbound webhook headers: `X-DeNoise-Delivery-Id` (UUID, stable across retries), `X-DeNoise-Event` (e.g. `episode.opened`), `X-DeNoise-Timestamp`, `X-DeNoise-Signature: v1=<hex>` when the destination has a signing secret. Signature = `hex(hmac_sha256(secret, timestamp + "." + rawBody))`. Retried: 5xx, 408, 425, 429, timeouts. Permanent 4xx and render failures go once to the mandatory fallback destination and raise `hub.delivery_failure`.
- Built-in templates (Liquid, sandboxed Fluid engine, 200 ms / 256 KiB, plain-data model): `generic-json`, `teams-adaptive-card` (Power Automate Workflows), `slack-blocks`, `plain-text`. Channels: outbound webhook and SMTP only.
- Application API conventions: session cookie `denoise_session` or `Authorization: Bearer ah_pat_<keyId>.<secret>` (personal access token from `POST /api/v1/me/tokens`); RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` with `type` `urn:denoise:error:*`; `If-Match: "<version>"` on mutations (428 missing, 409 mismatch); `Idempotency-Key` UUID on POST actions (24 h, byte-identical replay); cursor paging `{items, nextCursor, total?}`; repeatable filter params; 600 req/min/user; login 10/min/IP; bulk <= 200 items; camelCase JSON, RFC 3339 UTC, ISO 8601 durations; SSE stream with ids and replay.
- Application API resources (109 operations): episodes (queue, counts, detail, timeline, related, raw payload; ack, assign, note, close, restore, silence, refresh-state, bulk), integrations (CRUD, health, rotate-ingest-token, mappings with preview/activate, failures, divergence), replay, policies per kind (routing, escalation, lifecycle, grouping; versions, impact, activate, rollback), destinations (CRUD, pair, test, reveal, deliveries), webhook-templates (versions, render, activate), heartbeats (CRUD, preview, export/import YAML, pause, resume, rotate-token), suppressions (CRUD, preview-scope), groups, history, teams (overview, members), users, me (tokens, sessions, filters), config export/import (YAML bundle `denoise_config: 1`, dry-run diff), audit (keyset paging), hub (health, failures with retry, retention with run), auth (login, logout, csrf, change-password, reset, providers).
- RBAC roles: `viewer`, `operator`, `integration_admin`, `platform_admin`; every check also requires the resource's access scope to be within the user's scopes; out-of-scope resources return 404.
- Episode model: condition state (`firing`, `unknown`, `resolved`, `not_applicable`) independent from handling state (`new`, `acknowledged`, `closed`; rows may be `suppressed`). Closure reasons: `source_resolved`, `verified_resolved`, `inactivity_timeout`, `expired_unverified`, `manual_close`, `source_cancelled`; evidence: `source`, `api_verification`, `heartbeat_and_inactivity`, `inactivity_unverified`, `human`, `none`. A resolved episode that fires again opens a new linked episode.
- Coverage state per integration: `unknown -> healthy -> delayed -> degraded -> unavailable`; loss opens a coverage episode and suspends inactivity-based auto-resolve for that integration. Heartbeat states: `unknown`, `healthy`, `late`, `missed`, `paused`.
- Mapping DSL: declarative YAML, JSONPath (RFC 9535 subset), no scripting; rule kinds `path`, `const`, `first_nonempty`, `lookup` (map/regex_map), `template`, `object`, `pick`, `array`, `header`; transforms `lower`, `upper`, `trim`, `azure_subscription`, `azure_resource_group`, `hostname`, `sha256`, `truncate:N`; sections `fields`, `required`, `identity`, `enrich`, `applies_when`, `ignore_paths_for_body_key`, `lifecycle_profile_hint`; activation refused if any stored sample fails.
- Observability: `/healthz/live|ready|startup` on every host; Serilog JSON; OpenTelemetry traces and metrics via OTLP when `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` is set; metrics `denoise_ingest_accepted_total`, `denoise_ingest_rejected_total`, `denoise_episode_transitions_total`, `denoise_closure_total`, `denoise_delivery_attempts_total`, `denoise_mapping_failures_total`, `denoise_notification_latency_seconds`, `denoise_scheduler_lag_seconds`, `denoise_job_queue_depth`, `denoise_job_oldest_age_seconds`, `denoise_episode_open`, `denoise_unassigned_open`, `denoise_coverage_state`, `denoise_heartbeat_state`.
- Retention (daily 02:00 UTC on the scheduler role; `POST /api/v1/hub/retention/run` on demand): raw partitions > 30 d dropped; normalised events of closed episodes > 90 d, closed episodes > 12 months, delivery attempts / terminal outbox / done jobs > 30 d, audit > 12 months deleted in batches; open episodes never touched.
- Deployment: `docker compose --profile app up --build` for the full stack; `docker compose up -d postgres mailpit` plus `dotnet run` for development; Helm chart at `deploy/helm/denoise` (image `ghcr.io/softwareone/denoise`; required values `postgres.connectionSecret` with key `connectionString`, `auth.local.bootstrapPasswordSecret` with key `password`; optional `smtp.*`, `externalDeadmanUrl`, `retention.*`, `limits.*`, `auth.oidc.*`).
- Stack: .NET 10 / C# 14, ASP.NET Core minimal APIs, EF Core 10 + Npgsql (Dapper in hot paths), PostgreSQL 16 (schemas alert, hb, ops, audit, cfg), DB-backed job queue with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, transactional outbox, JsonPath.Net, YamlDotNet, Fluid, Cronos, MailKit, Argon2id, Serilog, OpenTelemetry; React 19, TypeScript strict, Vite, TanStack Router/Query/Virtual, Tailwind v4, Radix, CodeMirror, openapi-fetch, i18next; xUnit, FluentAssertions, FsCheck, Verify, Testcontainers; Vitest, Testing Library, MSW, Playwright + axe. Tests: 259 backend, 14 Playwright specs.
